items.label: Rich profile
items.scenario: Two people share this name, but only one is linked to the company you entered, so she is selected automatically and a full profile is built.

items.label: Name in Cyrillic
items.scenario: A Cyrillic search finds two different people with this name, so you choose which one to research.

items.label: Ambiguous name
items.scenario: Three different professionals share this name; compare their cards and pick the right one.

items.label: Sparse record
items.scenario: Only one public source exists, so the profile is short and states clearly what was not found.

items.label: Provider failure
items.scenario: News searches time out on the first run, giving a partial profile that a retry completes.

items.label: Profile URL match
items.scenario: A known profile page identifies the person directly, so no identity choice is needed.
